response.sql: WITH r AS (SELECT d.A3 AS region, AVG(CASE t.type WHEN 'PRIJEM' THEN t.amount WHEN 'VYDAJ' THEN -t.amount END) AS avg_amt, COUNT(*) AS txn_cnt FROM trans t JOIN account a ON a.account_id = t.account_id JOIN district d ON d.district_id = a.district_id GROUP BY d.A3), m AS (SELECT AVG(avg_amt) AS mean_avg FROM r) SELECT AVG(r.avg_amt) AS mean_of_avg, AVG(r.txn_cnt) AS mean_txn_count, AVG(r.avg_amt - m.mean_avg) AS mean_excess FROM r CROSS JOIN m WHERE r.avg_amt > m.mean_avg

assumptions.assumption: The region comes from the account's branch district (account.district_id joined to district.A3), not the client's district.
The cross-region mean is the unweighted mean of the regional averages. Regions whose average is NULL (no PRIJEM or VYDAJ rows) are left out of that mean and cannot pass the strictly-above filter.
Transactions of type VYBER, other types and NULL types are excluded from the average but still counted in the transaction count.
